game.title: Mad Max
game.blurb: Open-world post-apocalyptic action-adventure built around car combat, from Avalanche Studios, released 2015-08-31. RAWG average playtime: 11 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Max is robbed and left for dead by Scabrous Scrotus's War Boys, then builds a new car to fight back. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Wasteland Missions and Legend
chapters.summary: Optional Wasteland Missions and climbing the legend ranks.

chapters.title: Death Runs and Archangels
chapters.summary: Every Death Run type and location, and racing and fighting with each Archangel car.

chapters.title: Strongholds and Territory
chapters.summary: Building projects for Jeet, Gutgash and Pink Eye, and clearing threat in their regions.

chapters.title: Camps and Threats
chapters.summary: Top Dog and Scrotus camps, minefields, scarecrows, snipers and Vantage Outpost balloons.

chapters.title: Scavenging and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Hood ornaments, History Relics, scavenging locations, body colours, engines and scrap.

chapters.title: Life on the Road
chapters.summary: Driving and jumps, travelling on foot, water, food, upgrading Max and challenges.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has the game under "Mad Max" (no page under "Mad Max (2015)") at completion stage 1, but its Walkthrough and every mission page it links (such as "Dance with Death", "Magnum Opus", "Righteous Work") are not written; only Table of Contents, Achievements and trophies, Challenges, Gameplay and Controls exist, so it was not recorded in sw-structure.json and not used. madmax.fandom.com has no page under "Mad Max (2015)" ("Mad Max" is the 1979 film and "Mad Max (video game)" redirects to the 1990 game) but answers under "Mad Max (2015 video game)", with about 48 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. These results were merged into raw/mad-max.wiki.json. The Steam schema calls the app "BlackJack" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 234140. 5 of 49 Steam achievements are hidden; all have high unlock rates (28 to 77 percent) and sit in the main story chapter. "Fresh Air" (Magnum Opus jump) and "Maximum Air" fall in the life on the road chapter.
